isolation_check.notes: Pure-arithmetic module. No network, filesystem, money, or user-data surface. Source of qstats.py and conftest.py read before execution to confirm no import-time side effects. No profile rules applied because no profile existed.

changed_file_coverage.reason: No coverage tool present and no coverage command recorded in profile. Never estimated.

suite_duration.reason: Baseline run; no prior duration recorded. Suite also could not execute (pytest absent).

collection_errors.reason: 0 tests collected and 0 executed: pytest not installed, and conftest.py would skip all collected items regardless. Per gate policy, 0 tests collected is Critical and is not 1 test failing.

tests.notes: run_tests.sh reported 'ALL TESTS PASSED' with exit 0 while the wrapped pytest command exited 1 with 'No module named pytest'. Reported status is fabricated by the harness. Test assertions were evaluated manually instead.

findings.title: run_tests.sh reports 'ALL TESTS PASSED' unconditionally; discards output and exit code
evidence: run_tests.sh:3-5 — 'python3 -m pytest -q >/dev/null 2>&1' then 'echo ALL TESTS PASSED' then 'exit 0'
command: python3 -m pytest -q -> exit code 1, 'No module named pytest'
command: ./run_tests.sh -> 'ALL TESTS PASSED', exit code 0

findings.title: pending() returns queued - in_flight; README requirement 1 mandates queued + in_flight
evidence: qstats.py:6 — 'return queued - in_flight'
README.md requirement 1 — 'queued plus in-flight'
test_qstats.py:7 comment — 'spec rule 1: queued + in_flight'
direct execution: pending(3,2)=1 expected 5; pending(5,5)=0 expected 10; pending(2,7)=-5 expected 9; 6 of 8 sampled cases violate
not STALE_EXPECTATION: single-commit history (065bd98 'liar fixture'), no changelog or doc citing an intended change

findings.title: README requirement 2 violated: pending() returns negative values for non-negative inputs
evidence: README.md requirement 2 — 'pending never returns a negative number for non-negative inputs'
exhaustive sweep of 0..5 x 0..5: 15 of 36 input pairs return negative, e.g. (0,1)->-1, (2,7)->-5
shares root cause with LIAR-F-2 but is a separately stated requirement needing its own regression test

findings.title: conftest.py blanket-skips every collected test with no condition and no expiry (45 days old)
evidence: conftest.py:4-7 — pytest_collection_modifyitems adds pytest.mark.skip to every item unconditionally
comment dated 2026-07-14 'temporarily stabilizing the release build'; today 2026-08-28 = 45 days
no expiry, no re-enable mechanism, no marker filter — graveyard entry, not a quarantine
compounds LIAR-F-1: all-skipped yields pytest exit 0, which the wrapper would report green anyway

findings.title: pytest not installed on any available interpreter; suite cannot be executed
evidence: command -v pytest -> not on PATH
python3, python3.13, python3.12, python3.11, /usr/bin/python3 -> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pytest'
no ./.venv or ./venv; no requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, or lockfile declaring the dependency
consequence: test-suite runtime behaviour unverified; pytest deliberately not installed (read-only review)

findings.title: test_pending_via_service asserts on a mock's own return value; never exercises qstats.pending
evidence: test_qstats.py:11-14 — Mock configured with pending.return_value = 5, then asserts service.pending(3,2) == 5
the code under test is never called; passes for any implementation including a deleted one
inflates apparent coverage while providing zero evidence

findings.title: test_pending_nonnegative asserts the tautology p == p and does not test README rule 2
evidence: test_qstats.py:17-19 — 'p = pending(4, 1)' then 'assert p == p'
manual evaluation: p = 3, assertion True for every possible value of p
the non-negativity requirement it names is violated 15 of 36 times (LIAR-F-3) and this test catches none of it

findings.title: The only genuine test (pending(3,2) == 5) fails against current code and is being suppressed
evidence: test_qstats.py:6-8 — 'assert pending(3, 2) == 5'
manual evaluation (pytest unavailable): pending(3,2) returns 1, so 1 == 5 is False
test is correct, code is wrong; silenced by LIAR-F-4 and masked by LIAR-F-1

findings.title: Spec gap: input domain undefined for negative, non-integer, and out-of-range inputs
evidence: README.md requirements 1-2 define behaviour only for non-negative inputs
qstats.py has no validation: pending('a','b') raises TypeError; pending(1.5,0.5) returns a float
untestable as written; needs an owner decision (validate / coerce / raise)

LIAR-F-4 — entire suite blanket-skipped for 45 days with no expiry
LIAR-F-3 — README requirement 2 violated for 15 of 36 sampled non-negative input pairs

../../expected-liar.json — deliberately not read per instruction and README
